child.title: Add a child
child.description: Pick the switch that blocks this child's devices on your router (for UniFi, the switch for the child's group). On means blocked. If a router is connected, also pick the child's group so their devices can be listed.

router.title: Connect a router
router.description: Pick your router. Used only to list devices, their status and speeds; blocking works through Home Assistant switches. More router types can be added later.

unifi.title: Connect a UniFi router
unifi.description: Use a local UniFi admin with the View Only role. It is used only to list devices, their status and speeds; blocking works through Home Assistant switches and never needs this login.

site.title: Pick the UniFi site
site.description: This console manages more than one UniFi site. Pick the one your home network is in.

error.switch_in_use: Another child already uses this switch.
error.invalid_auth: UniFi rejected the username or password.

add_devices.title: Find devices
add_devices.description: Search the router's known devices by name, hostname or MAC. Wildcards work, e.g. *kobo*; plain text matches anywhere.

pick.title: Pick devices
pick.description: Pick the devices to show on this child's screen. A device outside the child's group is listed with its status; a device inside the group can be blocked on its own in the next step.

block.title: Per-device block (optional)
block.description: For each device you can pick a switch that blocks just that device ({devices}). Leave it empty to only list the device.

abort.no_router: Connect a router first: Add entry → Connect a router.

block.name: Block
block.description: Block the child's internet until Allow.

allow.name: Allow
allow.description: Turn the child's internet back on now. During bedtime, for the rest of the night.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Pause for a while when online, or allow for a while when blocked or at bedtime.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long. Leave empty to use the child's pause length.

refresh_devices.name: Check devices
refresh_devices.description: Fetch the child's devices, their status and speeds from the router now.

unknown_child.message: That child isn't set up in Parental Controls.

block_switch_missing.title: {child}'s block switch is {reason}
block_switch_missing.description:
Parental Controls blocks {child} through `{entity}`, which has been {reason} for a few minutes, so Block, Pause and bedtime can't reach the router.

If the switch was removed or renamed (for example the router integration or its rule was deleted), pick another one: **Settings → Devices & services → Parental Controls → {child} → Configure → Block switch and router group**. This notice clears by itself once the switch is back.

device_block_switch_missing.title: Block switch for {device} ({child}) is {reason}
device_block_switch_missing.description:
The switch that blocks {device} on its own, `{entity}`, has been {reason} for a few minutes, so its block button on {child}'s card can't work.

Pick another one, or remove the device: **Settings → Devices & services → Parental Controls → {child} → Configure → Remove devices**, then add it again with a new switch. This notice clears by itself once the switch is back.
